earned_by: WALLS-WITH-CHOICES-20261024-001B-E001 found that on 3 x 4 simple cycles of the wall graph misjudge classes of the four honeycomb placements with a free place (exactly 9168 configuration-class pairs per placement, 0.229% of the simple-cycle contradiction verdicts, computed from its frozen histograms), and WALLS-WITH-CHOICES-20261024-001D-P001 certified three such classes with 3, 3 and 5 cover sheets. READING-COST-20261024-001A-P001 proves that for the directed placements with a free place simple cycles always suffice. Scoping before this contract, all disclosed: 100000 sampled configurations of 159 and of 111 on 4 x 4 in twists 01 and 11 each (misjudged shares 0.12% to 1.0% of predicted contradictions, sheets 2 to 7), and 10000 sampled configurations of 159 and of 111 on 4 x 5 in twist 11 (no misjudgment among 415 predicted contradictions). The 4 x 4 part of P2 and P3 is therefore partly seen; P4 is fresh.
question: As the torus grows from 3 x 4 to 4 x 4 and 4 x 5, how often do simple cycles of the wall graph misjudge a class of the honeycomb placements with a free place, and how many cover sheets do the misjudged classes need?

public_inputs.placements: honeycomb placements with a free place 111, 125, 159, 215; directed placements with a free place 62, 110, 155, 203 as controls
public_inputs.tori_and_twists: 4 x 4 and 4 x 5, every non-fitting twist
public_inputs.classes: the 13 classes of the frozen 3 x 4 rows: (1,0) (0,1) (1,1) (1,-1) (1,2) (2,1) (1,-2) (2,-1) (1,3) (3,1) (3,-1) (3,2) (4,1); a class counts when it is odd for the twist
public_inputs.samples: per twist: 100000 configurations on 4 x 4 and 40000 on 4 x 5 for the honeycomb placements; 20000 and 10000 for the directed placements; drawn uniformly by splitmix64 in chunks of 10000 (4 x 4) or 2500 (4 x 5) with seeds fixed by run.py
public_inputs.engine: walls_sample.c: the wall graph and simple-cycle test of walls.c of WALLS-WITH-CHOICES-20261024-001B-E001, unchanged, with a sampling front end
public_inputs.truth: PySAT (CaDiCaL 1.5.3) on the clauses of DIRECTIONAL-RIGIDITY-20261023-001B-P001's check: no assignment on a strip of 12, 24 or 48 periods certifies a contradiction; otherwise cyclic covers with 1 to 24 sheets are tried in order and the first with an assignment gives the fewest sheets; a strip of 96 periods is tried last; else undetermined
public_inputs.baseline: 3 x 4: 9168 misjudged pairs among 4009750 simple-cycle contradiction verdicts per honeycomb placement (share 0.22864%), exact

definitions: A class is predicted to contradict when no simple cycle of the wall graph passes the criterion of the wall theorem. A predicted contradiction is misjudged when the class has an assignment (shown by a cyclic cover). The misjudged share is misjudged predicted contradictions divided by all predicted contradictions. Simple cycles never err the other way.

predictions.P1_directed_never_misjudged: theorem-predicted control (READING-COST-20261024-001A-P001, Theorem 6): no misjudged class for 62, 110, 155, 203 on either torus
predictions.P2_honeycomb_misjudged_on_both_tori: scoping-predicted on 4 x 4, fresh on 4 x 5: each of 111, 125, 159, 215 has at least one misjudged class on 4 x 4 and on 4 x 5
predictions.P3_honeycomb_share_4x4_above_3x4_each: scoping-predicted: for each honeycomb placement the misjudged share over all its 4 x 4 twists exceeds 0.22864%
predictions.P4_honeycomb_share_4x5_above_3x4_pooled: fresh: pooled over the four honeycomb placements and their 4 x 5 twists the misjudged share exceeds 0.22864%
predictions.reported: per placement and torus: samples, predicted contradictions, true contradictions, misjudged, undetermined, the fewest-sheets histogram of the misjudged classes, and the misjudged configurations

controls: (i) the three witnesses of WALLS-WITH-CHOICES-20261024-001D-P001 come out misjudged with 3, 3 and 5 sheets (frozen engine and truth procedure); (ii) on 200 sampled configurations walls_sample reports the frozen engine's patterns; (iii) 200 classes served by simple cycles have assignments; (iv) P1 is itself a control of the engine and of the truth procedure
decision_rule: If a control fails, including P1, the result is invalid. Supported if P2, P3 and P4 hold. Refuted if any of P2, P3, P4 fails; a refuted P4 means the misjudgment does not grow from 3 x 4 to 4 x 5 for the pooled honeycomb placements.
stop_rule: Run controls.py, then every chunk of run.py, writing rows as they finish; decide when all chunks are in. No adaptive extension.
seeds: chunk seeds are sha256 digests of placement, torus, twist and chunk index (run.py); controls use seed 20261024
environment: CPython 3 with PySAT in the repository's .venv; gcc (C99)
red_team_r0: The 4 x 4 part is partly seen: the scoping runs used the same placements and two of the twists with other seeds.
Sampling estimates a share; a refuted P4 on a small count could be noise. The counts are reported so the reader can judge.
Misjudgment is a property of simple-cycle search, not of the decision problem; growth suggests but does not show hardness.
Fewest sheets is capped at 24 and contradictions are certified only up to strips of 96 periods; undetermined cases are counted.
nonclaims: No complexity statement about the honeycomb placements with a free place.
No statement about tori other than 4 x 4 and 4 x 5, beyond the exact 3 x 4 baseline.
Lattices and twists are declared; nothing is said about space or physics.
forbidden_inputs: Expected patterns or verdicts as inputs; the 3 x 4 baseline enters only the comparison
